what: buildings and dwellings per building by street class, from the twin's own layout code (tiling.rs LeafLayout::build, run by the page's kernel holon_layout), MODEL

definitions.class: docs/geo/classes.json, from the layout's own people per km2 (holon_layout meta slot 4: households x 2.5 / leaf area) and checked against its DensityClass (meta slot 3; dense fabric = UrbanCore at >= 12,000)
definitions.leaf_area: w x h of holon_layout meta (HolonId::size_m: the holon's side lengths in metres at its centre latitude)
definitions.dwelling_building: a building with units >= 1; non_dwelling_buildings are village barns / sheds (units 0)
definitions.bands: dwellings per building 1, 2, 3-6, 7-12, 13+; buildings_by_dwellings_exact gives the raw counts
definitions.per_leaf: over the group's leaves: min, lower median (the floor((n-1)/2)-th of n sorted), max; per km2 of that leaf's area
definitions.footprint: floor(w x d / 10) x 10 m2 of each dwelling building (frontage x depth)
definitions.parameters: micro parameters at their defaults (the class thresholds and 2.5 persons per household are PARAM_SPECS MODEL values)

synthetic.scheme: per rung a uniform world at the rung's people per km2 (households per km2 = rung / 2.5); level-0 budgets round(households per km2 x area), splits by cos(child centre latitude) x 1e6 through holon_split_exact; the page's tree and leaf rule; the first 400 leaves holding households, in tree order, of the L3 tiles HOLON.make(3, i0, j0 + k), k = 0, 1, ..., (i0, j0) = HOLON.at(3, 51, 10); a leaf's seed is its id

real.scheme: every leaf of each place's L3 street tile, through the page's path (GHS-POP assets -> geoPopFine -> pop_load / pop_root / pop_split / pop_of -> HOLON.tree -> the leaf's context -> holon_layout)
